conversation.text: I have tingling in my feet, my vision is blurry in the lower left field, and I have a metallic taste in my mouth

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: How long have you had these symptoms?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: They all started at the same time, about 4 hours ago

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: A little dizziness, but no headache and no weakness

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This combination of symptoms is unusual. A nurse needs to evaluate you directly to determine if you need emergency imaging or other urgent testing.
